name: Terre di Offida

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A white wine from the Marche, from Ascoli Piceno and Fermo provinces. It is made as quality sparkling wine and from dried grapes as passito and vino santo.
